editor.title: Profile picture
editor.lead: Choose how other people see you.
editor.lead_organization: The logo is shown to everybody in the space.
editor.readonly: You can see this picture, but not change it.
editor.photo_prompt: Drop a photo here, or choose a file
editor.photo_hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to :mb MB. The photo is cropped to a square.
editor.crop_hint: Drag the image to frame it. With the keyboard, use the arrow keys. Use the control to zoom in.
editor.gravatar_text: Use the Gravatar picture tied to your e-mail. Switching it on sends the digest (hash) of your e-mail to Gravatar once to fetch the image; the copy is kept here and you can switch it off at any time.
editor.gravatar_text_on: Using your Gravatar picture. If you changed it there, refresh it here.
editor.gravatar_noemail: There is no known e-mail to look a Gravatar up by.
editor.gravatar_covered: An uploaded photo takes priority over Gravatar.
editor.style_lead: Without a photo you appear as a drawing made from your name. Pick the style.
editor.js_type: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
editor.js_read: This image could not be read.

validation.file_type: The photo has to be JPEG, PNG or WebP.
validation.file_corrupt: This image could not be read.
validation.file_pixels: The image is too large. Use a smaller one.
validation.file_small: The image is too small. Use one of at least :px px.
validation.multipart: The upload could not be read.
validation.files_off: Photo uploads are not switched on in this system.
validation.gravatar_off: Gravatar is not switched on in this system.
validation.gravatar_email: There is no e-mail to look a Gravatar up by.
validation.gravatar_none: We found no Gravatar for your e-mail.
validation.gravatar_unavailable: Gravatar did not answer just now. Try again in a moment.
validation.gravatar_kind: Only a person has a Gravatar.
validation.style: Choose one of the styles in the list.
